text: Rohto Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.'s largest shareholders (as of 2026-03-31) were The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account, 13.46%), State Street Bank and Trust Company (5.44%), Custody Bank of Japan (trust account, 4.92%) and Yamada Kosan LLC (3.72%, a founding Yamada family vehicle); no state or sovereign shareholder appears in the company's top-10 list.
short: Rohto's top holders are trust banks, State Street and the founding family's company; no state shareholder.
